fixed_operating_configuration.wot_and_boundary_conditions: Frozen Stage 1 project conditions; current open-end-plenum-v2 boundary identity retained; no boundary values changed
fixed_operating_configuration.fuel_and_mechanical_loss: Existing explicit synthetic configuration and provenance, unchanged

matrix.initial_state: Existing conservative remap from fixed base state; all extensive ledgers reported by setup helper

observables.pressure_amplitude: Peak-to-peak plus RMS and mean at cylinder and named exhaust interfaces; retain native primary signals
observables.pressure_phase_and_propagation: Compare only exact-angle samples / named-interface histories; report angular sampling bracket and signal coverage; no interpolation for gate comparison; missing common samples => INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
observables.flow: Signed boundary and named-interface mass-flow extrema and cycle integrals where complete primaries provide them
observables.periodicity: Existing REFERENCE_PERIODIC_CONVERGENCE_V2 detector and frozen thresholds; not changed

error_separation.spatial: 1/2/4/8 exhaust cells per named section at identical physical configuration and registered time-stepping policy; compare complete-cycle receipts, pressure/flow observables and conservation
error_separation.temporal: At fixed 8-cell-per-section mesh compare existing supported max-CFL 0.1/0.2/0.4 diagnostics, preserving all physical settings and exact detector; record dt distributions and common-angle residuals
error_separation.boundary: Boundary identity and parameters remain fixed during spatial/temporal sequence. Existing rigid-wall/open-end unit fixtures only test boundary implementation, not integrated-engine sensitivity. Integrated boundary uncertainty cannot be quantified without a separately preregistered physically supported alternative/range; therefore it remains a confounder and blocks a mesh-independence claim.

acceptance: No numerical acceptance thresholds are added by this preflight. Use only thresholds registered by a future explicit protocol. No MESH_INDEPENDENT claim unless decreasing refinement differences are below predeclared design-response uncertainty and temporal/boundary effects are independently bounded.

budget_proposal.basis: Prior EXHAUST_NUMERICAL_CONVERGENCE_V2 diagnostic protocol cap; this is a proposal only, not authorization. Existing 48-cell single point used 689.359 wall seconds for 4 cycles, so do not assume the mesh matrix fits without an updated measured runtime plan.
budget_proposal.memory_basis: Prior sampled peak 2,151,251,968 bytes exceeded 2048 MiB by about 4 MiB; proposed 3072 MiB is an explicit headroom proposal, not a measured requirement.
budget_proposal.checkpoint_policy: Per complete cycle, new isolated identity/root only; stop at hard wall or memory cap, preserve valid checkpoints, resume only after hash compatibility check.

historical_results.prior_spatial_matrices: Existing 1/2/4 and 1/2/4/8 studies remain material/non-monotonic; spatial independence NOT_ESTABLISHED
historical_results.periodicity: Historical 4/8 cycles; detector replay has all observed lag comparisons FAIL; full-horizon nonperiodicity not claimed
historical_results.preservation: Historical preregistration, primaries, checkpoints and receipts are not modified
